crates.name: Bronze Crate
crates.desc: Nailed shut with bronze bands. Mostly gold and tackle, but every so often something extraordinary rattles inside.

crates.name: Silver Crate
crates.desc: Silver-bound and humming with cold light. Better hauls and a real shot at a crate-only rod.

crates.name: Gold Crate
crates.desc: Black lacquer and gold filigree, light pouring out of every seam. The only crate where the rarest rods are more than a dream.

how_to_get: Weekly lucky draw: three random anglers who landed 20+ fish that week win a crate, whatever their rank.
Tournaments: one random angler who scored (not the winner) wins a Bronze Crate, plus a Silver draw in tournaments with 8+ anglers.
Bosses: slaying a boss or pulling on a crew Leviathan has a small chance to drop one.
Fishing: any fish you land has a tiny chance to come up with a crate tangled in the line.
Random events: a few times a day a surprise Hidden Goldfish, Shipwreck Salvage or Chat Quick-Draw pops up. Winners get a Bronze, Silver or Gold Crate.

rods.name: Reefsong Coral Rod
rods.perk: Reef Song: +5% bite chance and +2 luck on every cast.
rods.desc: Living coral grown around a whalebone core. Reef fish swear it sings.

rods.name: Moonreed Rod
rods.perk: Moonlit: +12% XP from every fish and 5% of casts cost no energy.
rods.desc: A single reed cut under a full moon, silvered with its light.

rods.name: Tempest Fang Rod
rods.perk: Stormcharged: 10% of casts cost no energy, fish weigh 8% more, never wears out.
rods.desc: A shark's fang set in storm-forged steel. Lightning still crawls along it.

rods.name: Emerald Wyrm Rod
rods.perk: Wyrmscale: +4 luck, fish weigh 12% more, +10% XP, never wears out.
rods.desc: Carved from jade that glows like a sea-dragon's eye. Fish feel it before they see it.

rods.name: Starfall Rod
rods.perk: Falling Star: 10% of landed fish bring a twin, +15% XP, 6% free casts, never wears out.
rods.desc: The night sky poured into a rod. A comet still trails the line.

rods.name: Abyssal Crown Rod
rods.perk: Crown of the Deep: 15% twin catches, fish weigh 20% more, +20% XP, +6 luck, +6% bite, 8% free casts, never wears out.
rods.desc: The crown of a drowned sea-king, fused to obsidian. The rarest rod in the Lands.

weather.text: A grey lid of cloud. Fish feed confidently.
Steady rain dimples the surface, the fish are up and feeding.
A storm churns the water. Dangerous, but strange things come up.
Thick fog. You can barely see your float.
A stiff wind makes casting awkward.

list.name: Old Grandfather
list.title: Grandfather's Bane
list.blurb: Millbrook's oldest resident. Every angler in the village has a story about the day it broke their line.

list.name: The Willow Wyrm
list.title: Wyrmslayer
list.blurb: Said to coil beneath the roots of the oldest willow and drag ducks under whole.

list.name: Greyfell's Shadow
list.title: Shadowbreaker
list.blurb: A shape that passes under boats on still mornings. Fishermen stop talking when they see it.

list.name: The Mudking
list.title: Kingslayer of the Marsh
list.blurb: Pushed far upriver by hunger and never left. The estuary belongs to it.

list.name: Harrowjaw
list.title: Harrowjaw's Bane
list.blurb: Lives in the wreck off the point. Divers who went looking came back with fewer fingers.

list.name: The Reef Emperor
list.title: Emperor's Bane
list.blurb: It does not hunt. It simply opens its mouth and the reef flows in.

list.name: Blackwater Maw
list.title: Mawbreaker
list.blurb: Rises to breathe with a sound like a door slamming. The mangroves shake.

list.name: The Pale Titan
list.title: Titanfall
list.blurb: Older than the settlement. Older, some say, than the ice.

list.name: The Drowned King
list.title: Crownbreaker
list.blurb: Rises before storms, trailing light. Sailors call it the herald of the drowned.

list.name: The Ghostlight Wyrm
list.title: Wyrm of the Deep Dark
list.blurb: It has never seen light. It does not need to. It hears your heartbeat through the water.

list.name: The Stone-Scaled Ancestor
list.title: Keeper of the Temple
list.blurb: The monks prayed to it. Then the lake rose and took the monks. It is still waiting at the altar.

list.name: The Cinder King
list.title: Kingslayer of the Cinders
list.blurb: Born in the mouth of the undersea volcano. The water around it is hot enough to cook bait on the hook.
